test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Zero tolerance

options.text: Riding in the front passenger seat of a car
A policy of not allowing any violations of a rule or law
To detect someone in the group is betraying the others
To escape and not have to pay

solution: The correct answer is **'Option 2'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct answer for the idiom** "Zero tolerance" **is "A policy of not allowing any violations of a rule or law"(शून्य सहनशीलता). • This **idiom is commonly used** in policies or rules where absolutely no exception will be made for violations. Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'A policy of not allowing any violations of a rule or law'.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Riding in the front passenger seat of a car** (एक कार की आगे की यात्री सीट में सवार होना) does not relate to the given idiom. • **To detect someone in the group is betraying the others** (समूह में किसी को धोखा देने का पता लगाना) refers to identifying a traitor within a group, not to the strict enforcement of rules. • **To escape and not have to pay** (भाग जाना और चुकाने की जरूरत नहीं होना) implies avoiding responsibility, which is not connected to the concept of zero tolerance. 3f:T915, The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**
